description: This file defines the interface for WAN Manager IPC operations, including function prototypes for starting IPC server, forcing DHCP renew, and setting interface status. It also conditionally declares a function for health check messaging.

methods.name: WanMgr_SendMsgToIHC
methods.description: Sends a message to the IHC health check component, conditionally compiled based on FEATURE_IPOE_HEALTH_CHECK

methods.name: WanMgr_StartIpcServer
methods.description: Starts the IPC server to handle WAN Manager clients

methods.name: Wan_ForceRenewDhcpIPv6
methods.description: Forces DHCPv6 renewal on the specified interface

methods.name: WanMgr_SetInterfaceStatus
methods.description: Sets the interface status for a given interface name
